notes.title: Dev Blog Vol. 1 - About the release postponement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is Toru Nakamura, Director of Vivid World.

First of all, I'd like to thank you for all your support, feedback, and encouragement!
My team and I regularly read all your comments and posts, often finding ourselves 
thinking, “Ah, that makes sense,” as if something clicks inside us.

Well, some of you may have already heard, but we’ve decided to push the release of 
Vivid World to later this year.
I’d like to take a moment to explain why, and what kind of progress we’re making.
From here on out, I plan to regularly share behind-the-scenes updates like this, 
so I hope you’ll drop by now and then to see how things are going.

[h2]🍎 About the Delay[/h2]
During our internal testing, we achieved a certain level of evaluation, 
and the feedback we received was generally positive. 
However, there was a common sentiment among us, that this isn’t where we stop.
We believed we could improve the game significantly. We knew we could go further, 
exceed expectations, and deliver something even stronger.

This realization led us to pause, step back, and decide to overhaul and refine what we had. 
Now, this redesign is taking shape, and we’re carefully incorporating everything needed to 
bring the game to completion... to deliver the best version of the game to you. 

When our most critical internal testers take back their earlier words and genuinely enjoy the game, 
we will know we can confidently release it for the world to see. 
We are committed to providing a true sense of satisfaction in the final product.

[h2]🍎 Key Updates & Improvements[/h2]
[h3]1️⃣ The “Out-Game” Elements... Rebuilt from [b]SCRATCH[/b][/h3]
This was a tough one, but we made the call to [b]completely redesign[/b] the game systems and 
User Interface (UI) outside of dungeon and battle gameplay. 
You might be wondering what the heck I mean by the "out-game," as this part has 
not been implemented in the Demo yet.
But behind the scenes, we’ve been working hard on this area too.
For example, there was a system called [b]Shards[/b] that got some attention in our Discord chats.
It was a cool concept that allowed players to strengthen individual units over time. 
But in the end, we realized that the whole concept of this feature conflicted with the 
pace and philosophy of a rogue-like game.
So, we made the difficult decision to scrap it.

It’s always painful to throw away a system we’ve put so much time and heart into. 
But if doing so leads to a more enjoyable experience overall, then it’s the right call.
And no worries, we’re introducing a couple of new mechanics inside the dungeons to compensate. 
There’s plenty to look forward to!

[h3]2️⃣ “In-Game” Content... More Strategic Depth[/h3]
Since the release of the demo, we've received a lot of feedback expressing a desire for 
the ability to upgrade units individually. We hear you!
So, we’re introducing some new systems that will add deeper layers of strategy 
in ways that may surprise you. 
While I can't share all the details just yet, we're exploring ideas such as:
[list]
[*] Certain units interact in unique ways
[*] Mechanisms that tweak unit appearance rates
[/list]
 ...and other features that add new dimensions to party building.
Our goal is to provide you with new options and decisions to make, all while ensuring 
the game remains intuitive and fun.

[h3]3️⃣ Character Controls... Smoother Than Ever[/h3]
We’re also improving how it feels to play.
It might sound minor, but a small improvement in how a character moves or 
reacts can have a big impact on the overall experience.
We’re adjusting and polishing until the moment-to-moment gameplay feels right.

[h2]🍎 Our Goal: Surpass Vivid Knight[/h2]
One of our objectives in developing Vivid World is to create a game that reaches 
[b]more players[/b] than Vivid Knight while providing an even [b]deeper experience[/b].  
That said… as we added new systems, we ran into a challenge:

[i]How do we balance[b] richness [/b]with [b]clarity[/b]?[/i]

We don’t want to overwhelm you with the flooding amount of gimmicks from the start.
To address this, we’ve designed the game so that systems unlock gradually over time, 
helping players ease into the complexity without feeling lost.
It’s all about achieving a balance between depth and accessibility, 
and we’re tuning every detail with care.

[h2]🍎 Where We Stand Now[/h2]
Right now, I’d say the game is around 90% complete.
However, this is just our internal assessment for the time being. 
We plan to conduct another round of internal testing to determine if we can confidently 
say that this is it.
We’re ready to rework that last 10%… or even take a step back if we have to.
Our goal is to ensure that we deliver a game we truly believe in. 
So please, hang in there with us just a little longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/04546dd9c428bcf862fd5b548b30950282de78dd.png[/img]

Thank you so much for reading all the way through.

I’ll continue to share our thoughts, our direction, and what’s happening behind the scenes 
as often as I can.
If you’re willing to walk with us a little longer, I promise it’ll be worth it.

See you in the next dev blog.

Toru Nakamura

notes.title: Discord Challenge vol. 4️⃣ Winners!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you so much for joining the [b]Discord Challenge vol.4[/b]!🥰

This week's challenge [b]💰The Snake year's best CARAT Hoarder💰[/b]'s goal was 
to save as much money (Carat) in the game and post a screenshot of your wallet 
until the total of all the posted Carat exceeds [b]10,000[/b]!

And, the total added up to...
[h3]10743 Carats!!💫[/h3]

At first, this goal seemed a bit ambitious, but you all consistently exceed our expectations!

All players who posted a screenshot of their wallet will earn an exclusive role with a unique icon! ✨
The winners of the challenge are as follows!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/5e35f1665ba80467a5cd6c3a5e68f6f8c42777ca.png[/img]

The role icon for this challenge is a Golden Amoeba, an object that appears by chance and gives away free money!
Oh how I wish we had something like this in real life too...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/ce32dcedb3c594776d903ffab76bdc9fc0ea9347.jpg[/img]

The role names are as follows...
English: [b]@Spring Caratster[/b]
Japanese: [b]@キーン運アップ！[/b]

The 5️⃣th challenge starts SOON!⭐️
This upcoming challenge will spotlight a feature that we didn't have much of a chance to experience...🥰
This one also needs an EXTRA TEAMWORK.🫨
Please be sure to give it a try again and collect another special role with new art!

notes.title: Regarding the release date of Vivid World
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you so much for playing the demo of "Vivid World" and for all your valuable feedback! 

Today, we have an important announcement regarding the full release date of the game. Previously, our expected release date was set for Q1 2025 on our store page. However, we have decided to extend this date to Q2 2025. 

The game is approximately 90% complete, but as we continue its development, we want to ensure that we make it to the launch in the best shape possible. Our goal is to provide you with a gaming experience that exceeds what you encountered in the demo, and this commitment only grows stronger every day. 
We appreciate your patience and support as we take a little extra time to polish the game.

Lastly, allow us to share a few screenshots of our current developments! You’ll see some new gems that you haven’t encountered before, and familiar NPC characters you met in some of the dungeons, now updated and becoming a member of the party🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/29a3b105f85f6439dfc8ebab1ca5e8c6e7152492.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/8bf4ed26957a1cfc098dcdcb971b8878bbaf1154.png[/img]

There are still many surprises awaiting you in the full version, including UNDISCLOSED MAPS and bosses😈
Stay tuned! 

We will keep you updated through our official X, Discord, and Steam News, so pretty please be sure to follow us!

[h3][b][url=https://x.com/VividKnight_O]Vivid Series Official X[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/QSvU8ggv55]Asobism Official Discord Server[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: New Discord channel and challenge event! This is going to be fun...♡
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It has already been two months since the Demo release of Vivid World...
We are so grateful for all of you who have downloaded and played the game🥹
Thanks to all of your feedback, the development of Vivid World is going well!

We are writing this news to inform you all that we are now taking an experimental measure on Discord to offer more fun playing Vivid World!

[h3][b]"🍎┊Challenge from Alchemist Ostanes"[/b][/h3]
This is a channel where all Vivid World lovers come to brag about their play record!
Clear the stage with the themed challenge we set, and post the screenshot of the result page to brag about your clear time!
Players with the best score will be rewarded with a cool role😂

The first theme is...

[h3][b]━━━━━━*＼🎅🏻Lone-wolf Christmas challenge🎅🏻／*━━━━━━[/b][/h3]

[b]"Transient Dream" ONE UNIT Time Attack 🐠[/b]
Compete the time to clear the stage "Transient Dream" with only one party member!
Both screenshots and videos are welcome as long as it includes the result screen!

Top scorers will be awarded with a role... [b]"Christmas Lone-wolf"🐺⛄️[/b]

⏰Challenge ends: Tuesday, December 24th 6:59 am PST

*This is not an RTA (real-time attack), and you will compete with the “Clear Time” 
displayed on the result screen of the game.
*You do not need to go through the whole stage with only one unit, just the 
final boss stage is what matters!

[h3][b]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/b][/h3]

If you are one of the players who felt that just clearing the stages was too mainstream, come visit the channel to see how it is like!

This channel is run in a new category named [b]"VIVID SERIES_BORDERLESS"[/b], where all users with a role related to Vivid World can view. Users of any language are welcome to interact!

notes.title: 💎 Demo Version 0.9.2.17 Update 💎
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this update, we mainly focused on fixing bugs.

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't match with friends in multiplayer.
[*] Corrected a problem where restarting after a defeat in the tutorial led to game progression being blocked.
[*] Resolved an issue where the overweight warning text was narrowing the clickable area.
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera moved to an unintended position after ending a battle with the "Holy Curse" unit effect.
[*] Corrected the "Mercy" player effect which was not being applied correctly.
[/list]


Vivid World continues to improve by listening to your voices. We look forward to hearing more of your opinions!
 (This is a machine translation.)

However, we occasionally feel the limit to what we can offer without a wider perspective.
